title: The Farmer and the Cranes
summary: Cranes ate a farmer's newly sown seed. When the farmer merely shouted and waved his hands, the birds laughed and continued eating....
full_text:
Cranes ate a farmer's newly sown seed. When the farmer merely shouted and waved his hands, the birds laughed and continued eating.

When the farmer loaded stones into his sling and struck down three birds, the rest flew away, learning that empty shouting had turned into real force.
moral: Words without resolve provoke mockery; resolute action commands respect.
